Privacy Policy

Last updated: June 3, 2026

8a0 (available at 8a0.com.br) is a free game where you build a dream national team and simulate a result. This policy explains what data the site uses and how advertising works. By using 8a0, you agree to the practices described here.

Data we collect

8a0requires no sign-up and collects no name, email or personally identifiable data to play. The core of the game runs in your own browser. We may store:

  • Local preferences (such as your chosen theme), kept only in your browser.
  • Share links: when you share a team, we generate a short code. That code holds only the composition of the generated team — no information about you.
  • Aggregate traffic metrics (number of visits, country, device) provided by Cloudflare's infrastructure, without identifying individual users.

Cookies and advertising

To keep 8a0 free, we show ads through Google AdSense. Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on prior visits to this and other sites.

  • Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to you based on your browsing.
  • You can opt out of personalized advertising in Google's Ads Settings.
  • Learn how Google uses data when you use our services at google.com/policies/technologies/partner-sites.
  • For third-party vendor options, visit aboutads.info/choices.

Third-party services

Besides Google AdSense, 8a0 loads fonts from Google Fonts and may show a support link to Ko-fi. These services have their own privacy policies.

Children

8a0 is not directed at children under 13 and does not knowingly collect data from children.

Changes

This policy may be updated periodically. Relevant changes will be reflected on this page, with the update date at the top.

Contact

Questions about this policy? Reach us via the support page: ko-fi.com/8a0wc.
